description: Lists the Accessibility Scans in the connected account, newest first. An Accessibility Scan measures a sample of the website's pages against automated WCAG 2.x A and AA checks, grouped by page template. Each item has its id, the website (target_domain), status (draft, importing, awaiting_review, pending_payment, paid, running, completed, failed or cancelled; the first three are the free sitemap import and page review), whether it is a re-scan of an earlier scan's pages (sample_mode same_as_prior) or a first scan (fresh), the approved and measured page counts, the number of page templates, client_id, diagnostic_report_id, and created and completed dates. Filters: client_id and status. An empty page means none were returned for these filters, not that the account has none or that Yellowhead does not offer the scan.
